'''Stinkears''' is one of the [[goblin raider bosses]] that appears in [[Goblin Village]] after the player kills 15 [[goblin]]s. He attacks with very accurate [[magic]] attacks. He shouts "Zap! Dat's da way!" and other phrases upon arrival. This goblin boss will always drop either equipment or [[runes]], along with any other non-equippable item.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Ranged ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Magic ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Melee ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Early-Game Rebalance|date=16 February 2026}}
** A number of early-game mobs will once again drop actual armour, weapons, ores, and bars.
*** Tin stone spirit → Tin ore
*** Small spiky bronze salvage → Bronze spear
*** Small bladed bronze salvage → Bronze scimitar/Bronze off hand scimitar
*** Small plated bronze salvage → Bronze full helm
*** Small plated iron salvage → Iron square shield

* {{UL|type=update|update=What's Mine is Yours|date=17 October 2012}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
* His examine text, "Now they are shooting fireballs. Perfect." may be a reference to ''{{wp|Artemis Fowl}}'', a book series where goblins can conjure and throw fireballs.
